The '''''Shae'en M'taal''''' is an [[Aiel]] [[Aiel warrior society|warrior society]]. The name means "Stone Dogs" in the [[Old Tongue]].

==Role==
''Shae'en M'taal'' are often used as rear guards.{{ref/book|4|36}}{{ref/book|5|23}} They also vow not to retreat once battle has begun and will perish to the last to meet this vow.{{ref/book|2|g}}

==Activities==
[[File:Mangin.jpg|thumb|left|[[Mangin]], of the [[Jindo]] sept of the [[Taardad]] Aiel]]
A six-man team of ''Shae'en M'taal'', including [[Gaul]], guarded [[Rand al'Thor]]'s quarters in the [[Stone of Tear]].{{ref/book|4|7}} ''Shae'en M'taal'' once guarded [[Hadnan Kadere]]'s wagons as they traveled through the [[Aiel Waste|Three Fold Land]].{{ref/book|5|46}} All of the societies, including the ''Shae'en M'taal'', accompanied Rand al'Thor from the [[Sun Palace]] in [[Cairhien]] to [[Caemlyn]] in [[Andor]] to battle [[Rahvin]] and his forces.{{ref/book|5|54}} ''Shae'en M'taal'', along with ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]'' and ''[[Seia Doon]]'' are very touchy about ''[[ji'e'toh]]''.{{ref/book|4|23}}{{ref/book|7|40}}
